description: Use this when someone asks where to eat gluten-free or with celiac disease, in a place they name or near them. People ask it like "gluten free restaurants in Chicago", "where can I eat with celiac disease in Paris", "dedicated gluten-free bakery near me", "gluten free pizza in Brooklyn", "celiac friendly tacos in Austin" or "I'm celiac and visiting Tokyo next month, where should I eat?". Returns places from Sansglu's gluten-free database on a map, each with its gluten-free label and its own website as the source. Do not use for recipes, packaged foods or grocery brands, ingredients, booking tables, hotels, symptoms or other medical questions.

label_filter.description: Use "dedicated_gf" only when the person asks for fully gluten-free (dedicated) places.

limit.description: How many places to return. Use 8 for trip planning.

query.description: What the person asked for and the area they named, in their words, for example "dedicated gluten-free bakery in Austin" or "Nami Nori Williamsburg". Never a street address or coordinates.

name: find_gluten_free_places
title: Find gluten-free places
